name: S4.2 fix golden set
description: Build Bible §19 S4.2 evaluation dataset, v1: 10 broken Playwright tests with known root causes — the S4.2 exit gate (§31.7: ≥ 5/10 fixes applicable and passing, with the correct action per §26). Each fixture is one broken test: the raw failure text (must classify into `category` through the S3.3 normalizer), the broken test file, and the expected outcome — has_fix=true carries the known-good fixed file (test-side patch; the offline oracle reference); has_fix=false is a decline case (product/environment defect — the correct action is to decline, §26: never "fix" a test to hide an app bug). app_env pins the defect-injection flags the live Playwright verifier must run against (empty = clean stack).
